# Sensors

<!-- Written by site/build.py from App/Sender.swift (the addresses) and WebUI/home.html (what each sensor does). Change those and run it again; do not edit this file. -->

Every value has its own address under `/sensorlove`, with one number in it, or one text. A destination's PREFIX goes right after the root: `/sensorlove/phone1/accel/x`. [OSC](osc.md) tells how the values travel.

## ATTITUDE

Which way the phone is facing: pitch tips it forward, roll tilts it sideways, yaw turns it around. Hold it like a steering wheel or a camera and map it to rotation.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/attitude/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/attitude/pitch` | RAD |
| `/sensorlove/attitude/roll` | RAD |
| `/sensorlove/attitude/yaw` | RAD |

</details>

## QUATERNION (QUAT)

The same orientation as ATTITUDE, as four numbers. Use it to rotate 3D objects: it never flips or locks up when you point straight up or down.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/quaternion/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/quaternion/x` | -1 TO 1 |
| `/sensorlove/quaternion/y` | -1 TO 1 |
| `/sensorlove/quaternion/z` | -1 TO 1 |
| `/sensorlove/quaternion/w` | -1 TO 1 |

</details>

## GRAVITY

Which way is down. Tilt the phone and the values follow, smooth and without shake. The easiest way to steer something by tilting.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/gravity/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/gravity/x` | G |
| `/sensorlove/gravity/y` | G |
| `/sensorlove/gravity/z` | G |

</details>

## GYROSCOPE (GYRO)

How fast the phone is spinning. Still is 0. Twist it quickly to trigger things, or let the spin drive a speed.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/gyro/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/gyro/x` | RAD/S |
| `/sensorlove/gyro/y` | RAD/S |
| `/sensorlove/gyro/z` | RAD/S |

</details>

## ACCELEROMETER (ACCEL)

Every force on the phone, gravity included. Knocks, taps and bumps show up right away.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/accel/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/accel/x` | G |
| `/sensorlove/accel/y` | G |
| `/sensorlove/accel/z` | G |

</details>

## USER ACCELERATION (U.ACCEL)

Only your movement, with gravity taken out. Shake, swing or punch the air: made for gestures and hits.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/useraccel/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/useraccel/x` | G |
| `/sensorlove/useraccel/y` | G |
| `/sensorlove/useraccel/z` | G |

</details>

## LOCATION

Where the phone is and how fast it moves. Slow to update, but great for walks, rides and site-specific work. Needs location permission.

**Permission:** LOCATION

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/location/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/location/lat` | DEG |
| `/sensorlove/location/lon` | DEG |
| `/sensorlove/location/alt` | M |
| `/sensorlove/location/speed` | M/S |
| `/sensorlove/location/heading` | DEG |
| `/sensorlove/location/address` | TEXT |

</details>

TEXT comes as an OSC string.

## MAGNETOMETER (MAGNET)

The magnetic field around the phone. Bring a magnet or a speaker close and watch it jump. Also a rough compass.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/magnet/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/magnet/x` | µT |
| `/sensorlove/magnet/y` | µT |
| `/sensorlove/magnet/z` | µT |

</details>

## BAROMETER (BARO)

Air pressure, and how far you went up or down. Lift the phone above your head and you will see it move.

**Permission:** MOTION

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/pressure/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/pressure/kpa` | KPA |
| `/sensorlove/pressure/altitude` | M |

</details>

## WEATHER

The weather where the phone is, from Open-Meteo.com: temperature (°C), how it feels, humidity, rain (mm), clouds, wind (m/s) and where it comes from, pressure (hPa), day or night, and the sky (WMO's code; in words at /sensorlove/weather/text, for an OSC In DAT). New every 15 minutes, and sent again every 5 seconds for a patch opened later. Needs your location, which goes out rounded to about 1 km. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com.

**Permission:** LOCATION

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/weather/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/weather/temp` | °C |
| `/sensorlove/weather/feels` | °C |
| `/sensorlove/weather/humidity` | % |
| `/sensorlove/weather/rain` | MM |
| `/sensorlove/weather/clouds` | % |
| `/sensorlove/weather/wind` | M/S |
| `/sensorlove/weather/winddir` | DEG FROM |
| `/sensorlove/weather/pressure` | HPA |
| `/sensorlove/weather/isday` | 0 / 1 |
| `/sensorlove/weather/code` | WMO |
| `/sensorlove/weather/text` | TEXT |

</details>

TEXT comes as an OSC string.

## TOUCH

Where up to five fingers are, from 0 to 1, and how many. Each keeps its number until it lifts. Touch the monitor, or open the pad to play the whole screen like an XY controller.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/touch/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/touch/count` | 0-5 |
| `/sensorlove/touch/1-5/x` | 0-1 |
| `/sensorlove/touch/1-5/y` | 0-1 |
| `/sensorlove/touch/1-5/down` | 0 / 1 |
| `/sensorlove/touch/1-5/radius` | PT |

</details>

## MICROPHONE (MIC)

How loud it is around the phone, from 0 to 1. Clap, talk or play music to drive light and sound.

**Permission:** MICROPHONE

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/mic</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/mic` | 0-1 |

</details>

## PROXIMITY (PROX)

The sensor next to the earpiece: 0 when something is close, 1 when clear. Wave a hand over it for a simple on / off trigger. It is a bit shy.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/proximity</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/proximity` | 0 / 1 |

</details>

## BATTERY

How full the battery is, from 0 to 1. Handy in long installations: slow the piece down or warn before the phone dies. The wizard lives on it: full, he flies; then he sits, dozes off, and when it runs out there is only his grave.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/battery</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/battery` | 0-1 |

</details>

## TIME

The phone's clock and calendar: hour, minute, second, how far the day has gone (0 to 1), the date, the weekday (1 is Monday) and the day of the year. For pieces that follow the day, or several phones on one clock. What changes slowly also goes out every 5 seconds, for a patch opened later. The hourglass runs a minute.

<details>
<summary>Addresses <code>/sensorlove/time/*</code></summary>

| Address | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `/sensorlove/time/hour` | 0-23 |
| `/sensorlove/time/minute` | 0-59 |
| `/sensorlove/time/second` | 0-60 |
| `/sensorlove/time/dayprogress` | 0-1 |
| `/sensorlove/time/year` | YEAR |
| `/sensorlove/time/month` | 1-12 |
| `/sensorlove/time/day` | 1-31 |
| `/sensorlove/time/weekday` | 1 MON-7 SUN |
| `/sensorlove/time/yearday` | 1-366 |

</details>

**Permission:** CAMERA

## NDI VIDEO (VIDEO)

The camera as video on your network: an NDI® source called SENSORLOVE VIDEO, for TouchDesigner (NDI In TOP), OBS, Resolume, vMix or any app that takes NDI. It stands up the way you hold the phone, and each frame carries the lens and, on the back camera with DEPTH on, where the phone is. NDI ↗: its size, its name, the people cut out (MATTE) and the sound. Nothing is worked on while no one watches. NDI® is a registered trademark of Vizrt NDI AB.

**Permission:** CAMERA

**Sent as:** an NDI® source, not OSC. [NDI](ndi.md) tells how to take it in.

## NDI DEPTH (DEPTH)

How far everything is, as video on your network: an NDI® source called SENSORLOVE DEPTH, in 16-bit video. Near is white and it fades to black at FAR, by 1/distance, so near things get the detail; black is also nothing measured. FAR's AUTO follows the scene; FACE gives all of it to the nearest 40 cm, a face's relief; EQ spreads the greys by how much of the picture is at each distance, the most detail to see. SMOOTH is iOS's own smoothing; off, each frame comes as measured. DETAIL AI adds what the depth camera cannot see, edges, hair and folds, from Depth Anything on the phone's Neural Engine, tied to the sensor's distances every frame; SENSOR sends the depth camera's own. Either way it comes at VIDEO's size, its edges on the picture's. LiDAR on the back camera (Pro iPhones), TrueDepth on the front. Each frame carries the lens, its near and far and, on the back camera with MATTE on, where the phone is: in TouchDesigner (NDI In TOP, Input Pixel Format Native) that is all a point cloud needs. NDI® is a registered trademark of Vizrt NDI AB.

**Permission:** CAMERA

**Sent as:** an NDI® source, not OSC. [NDI](ndi.md) tells how to take it in.
